reviews.conclusion: The player enters the End exit fountain after the dragon fight. A black-to-dirt background with the Minecraft Java Edition logo scrolling upward occupies approximately 12.25-12.75 s before an overworld scene returns. This end-credit-style sequence is compatible with the 12.4333 s GUI-clock deficit. The on-screen run timer remains at its completed value during these screens. This is observed post-completion screen behavior, not evidence of a cut.

Three menu appearances occupy approximately 0.75-2.25 s in total, less than the 3.0667 s deficit even at the sampling upper bound. Narrowed/obscured game-window phases occupy another approximately 2.75-3.75 s, but their pause state cannot be established from this proxy. Ordinary menu/window-management behavior is directly observed; exact deficit accounting remains unresolved and is not forced closed.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
